headline: 683 children dead as measles death toll rises in Bangladesh
summary: Three more children died within 24 hours, bringing the total number of deaths from measles and measles-like symptoms to 683 since March 15.
details: According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), three more children died within the last 24 hours due to symptoms of measles.
In the same period, 1,125 children were reported to be suffering from measles or measles-like symptoms across the country.
Since March 15, the total number of deaths attributed to measles and measles-like symptoms has reached 683.
Of these total deaths, 590 children died with measles-like symptoms, while 93 deaths were confirmed cases of measles.
The DGHS provided these details in its regular measles bulletin released on Thursday (June 18).

headline_marked: Ex-MP Sabina Yasmin and [[Woman's League leader shown arrested]] in July uprising cases
headline: Ex-MP Sabina Yasmin and Woman's League leader shown arrested in July uprising cases
summary: A Dhaka court has ordered the arrest of former MP Sabina Yasmin and Rokeya Jamal in separate cases related to the murder and attempted murder of protesters during the July uprising.
details: A Dhaka metropolitan magistrate's court has ordered that former reserved seat MP Sabina Yasmin and Rokeya Jamal, president of the Kafrul Thana Women's League, be shown arrested in separate cases.
The order was given by Metropolitan Magistrate Ariful Islam on Monday after hearing applications from police officers of the Mirpur Model Thana and Kafrul Thana.

Sabina Yasmin was produced in court for an attempted murder case filed at Mirpur Model Thana. The case involves an incident on August 4, 2024, where a man named Milon Panna was shot during the protests.
The case against Sabina Yasmin also includes former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and 400 to 500 other unknown persons.
Rokeya Jamal was produced in court for a murder case filed at Kafrul Thana. The case relates to the incident where Md. Shakil, who was shot in the Mirpur-10 area, later died from his injuries.
Defense lawyers opposed the applications for arrest, but the court granted the request based on the State's prosecution.
Both women were produced in court today, Monday, following the police applications for their formal arrest in these specific cases.
caption:
Former MP Sabina Yasmin and a Women's League leader have been formally arrested in cases involving murder and attempted murder during the July uprising.

A Dhaka metropolitan magistrate's court has ordered that former reserved seat MP Sabina Yasmin and Rokeya Jamal, president of the Kafrul Thana Women's League, be shown arrested in separate cases.

The order was given by Metropolitan Magistrate Ariful Islam on Monday after hearing applications from police officers of the Mirpur Model Thana and Kafrul Thana.

Sabina Yasmin was produced in court for an attempted murder case filed at Mirpur Model Thana. The case involves an incident on August 4, 2024, where a man named Milon Panna was shot during the protests.

The case against Sabina Yasmin also includes former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and 400 to 500 other unknown persons.

Rokeya Jamal was produced in court for a murder case filed at Kafrul Thana. The case relates to the incident where Md. Shakil, who was shot in the Mirpur-10 area, later died from his injuries.

Defense lawyers opposed the applications for arrest, but the court granted the request based on the State's prosecution.

Both women were produced in court today, Monday, following the police applications for their formal arrest in these specific cases.
